Join the FRONTFLIPERS group to unlock a FREE gift in-game!

JOIN IN THE WEEKEND FOR X3 MULTIPLIERS

🍫 Welcome to +1 Backflip Keyboard Escape! 🍫

⚡ Every backflip = +1 Speed
🤸 Flip, jump, and escape across a world made of candy & chocolate keyboard keys
👟 Train your speed and unlock powerful multipliers
👥 Race against friends and other players
🌍 Become the FASTEST flipper on the server
🚀 Speed is everything… but one wrong move and you’re back at the start 😱

🎧 ASMR vibes included
Smooth movement, satisfying keyboard clicks, creamy visuals, and relaxing candy sounds for the perfect mix of speed, flips, and chill ✨
